$comment: Authored, not generated: events that clients send on a topic, which private.broadcast() in the migrations cannot show. The realtime.messages INSERT policy lets any participant who may join a topic send on it (private.may_join_topic); a broadcast is a courtesy and never a record (ADR-0009). Receivers validate every payload and treat a malformed one as absent.

provider.location.sender: the provider or worker on the job, while it is en_route, arrived or in_progress
provider.location.cadence: about every 5 s while moving (the app's distance filter is 20 m); nothing when stationary

is_mock.description: the platform's mock-location flag, as reported by the device

at.description: device time of the fix, UTC

provider.location.persisted: No. The same position reaches the database only through the movement-gated heartbeat RPC, which writes provider_live_location and, on a job, location_samples.
